# Zeel Kumbhani — Ethical Hacker & AI Security Expert

> Zeel Kumbhani is an ethical hacker, AI security expert, and cybersecurity consultant based in Surat, Gujarat, India. He is the Founder & CEO of CyberNexora, a cybersecurity company providing VAPT, penetration testing, AI/LLM security, and compliance services to businesses across India and worldwide.

## About

Zeel Kumbhani specializes in finding and fixing security vulnerabilities in websites, web applications, APIs, SaaS platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI/LLM applications. His approach combines manual penetration testing with clear, actionable reporting — helping businesses stay secure and meet compliance requirements.

- Name: Zeel Kumbhani
- Role: Ethical Hacker, AI Security & Cybersecurity Consultant
- Company: CyberNexora (Founder & CEO)
- Location: Surat, Gujarat, India
- Serves: India and worldwide

## Expertise

- VAPT (Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing)
- Web Application Security & Penetration Testing
- AI & LLM Security (prompt injection, jailbreaks, model abuse)
- Vibe-Coding & AI-Generated Code Security Review
- API Security Testing (OWASP API Top 10)
- SaaS & Product Security Testing
- Cloud Security Assessment (AWS, Azure, GCP)
- Network Penetration Testing
- Malware Removal & Incident Response
- Cybersecurity Compliance & Cyber-Law Audit
- Security Awareness Training

## Compliance & Standards

Compliance and cyber-law audits mapped to: DPDP Act (India), GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001, SOC 2, IT Act 2000, CERT-In, and OWASP.
